item.title: Who is eligible to participate in SIBACOM competitions?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: SIBACOM is open to all enrolled undergraduate and graduate students from recognized universities, degree-awarding institutions, and colleges across Pakistan. Valid student identity cards or institutional authorization letters are required during badge issuance.

item.title: How do team registrations and external payment links work?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Each event card on the homepage and Events page provides a direct Register Now button linking to the official external portal configured by the organizing team. Follow the on-screen instructions on the external portal to register your team roster and verify payment.

item.title: Can a single participant register for multiple competition categories?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes, provided the scheduled time slots for your chosen events do not directly overlap. Please review the official event schedule before finalizing your registrations.

item.title: Is on-campus accommodation available for outstation teams?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes. Dedicated student hostel accommodations are arranged on a pre-reserved basis for outstation university contingents. Teams should indicate accommodation requirements on their official registration form.

item.title: What hardware and development kits are provided for robotics and IoT?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Teams participating in Autonomous Robotics and Embedded Hardware must bring their own microcontrollers, sensors, chassis, and soldering equipment. The university provides regulated AC power outlets, standard testing tracks, and calibration bench facilities.

item.title: When and where will cash prizes and trophies be awarded?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Official shields, cash prize cheques, and certificates of merit will be presented during the Grand Awards Gala on Day 3 in the Main University Auditorium in the presence of distinguished patrons and chief guests.
